premises.text: Homes waste energy and comfort because rooms stay heated/cooled when unused under central HVAC
premises.evidence_span: average of two to four rooms that are overheated or overcooled at various times

premises.text: KeenVent wireless vents in unoccupied rooms automatically redirect airflow from the central unit
premises.evidence_span: KeenVents are placed in rooms throughout the home that are unoccupied for large portions of the day

premises.text: DIY vent swap plus Lifestyle Survey smart-cycle programming gets the system running in minutes
premises.evidence_span: have the system up and running in minutes

premises.text: Online account enables ongoing services such as severe-weather schedule alerts
premises.evidence_span: if severe weather were forecasted for one of our customers' homes, we would send an alert

premises.text: Go-to-market moves from web to retail and subsidized builder/utility partnerships
premises.evidence_span: partner with home builders, HVAC suppliers, and utility companies to sell the Keen Vent to their customers with some form of subsidy

premises.text: Subscription versus lifetime pricing models monetize the four-vent system
premises.evidence_span: This is our subscription model. The same four-vent system will be sold for $150 with no monthly service fee

value.text: Comfortable efficient homes with less HVAC runtime
value.evidence_span: reduces the HVAC system runtime needed to reach the desired temperature

causal_links.evidence_span: services that Keen Home will provide to its customers

notes: Singleton D2: post-install services framed as separately claimed value path. Efficiency study % folded into product benefits via D1. 40M homes market framing excluded.
